property_summary: After any successful call to fallback, the stored pastBlockTime must equal the block timestamp of that call (c.pastBlockTime() == block.timestamp); the mutant stores block.number instead, so it violates this for any input where block.number != block.timestamp.
change_summary: Replace `pastBlockTime = block.timestamp;` with `pastBlockTime = block.number;` so the variable stores the block number instead of the timestamp.
